browser_qa.environment: Codex in-app browser on Heather’s Mac
controls: bounded damped cursor gaze / independent specimen rotation
physical felt stone box: tiger eye, diamond, emerald
physical metal box: gold and silver
direct shade dragging with actual light movement
world-space loupe pickup, high/front clearance corridor, and reversible return
2x/3x loupe projection and ring/loose-stone camera retargeting
keyboard alternatives and small-screen bench controls
journal with all three reference images loaded
PNG download from the animated inspection camera

pickup_reversal_observed.note: UI animation progress decreased after Escape; full reversal invariants also covered by unit tests.

browser_qa.responsive_note: Actual CSS widths, not requested viewport pixels. The IAB viewport override produced inconsistent capture scaling; it was reset and final screenshots use a fresh 1280x720 normal tab.
browser_qa.reduced_motion: Code path disables gaze parallax and candle flicker and shortens pickup duration; preference emulation was not browser-tested.
browser_qa.hover_and_pointer_targets: Observed physical clicks for diamond, emerald, silver and loupe. Lamp drag changed reach/height; empty canvas does not turn jewelry.
browser_qa.lamp_drag: Pointer-ray intersection with the head’s z=-1 movement plane preserves grip offset; verified drag changed reach 48→82 and height 28→8 at the bounded lower limit.

deployment.browser_handoff: Authenticated hosted UI verified at the production URL: physical diamond selection, complete loupe pickup/return, no console errors. Local QA additionally covered lamp/metal controls and other layouts.

limits: Tiger eye is an artist-tuned surface model, not measured volume optics
Loupe uses camera projection and a 3D eyepiece, not ray tracing through a designed optical lens
Live browser GPU, Rust CPU, and external Mitsuba outputs are credited separately
Pickup clearance uses conservative proxies and mounted-gem bounds, not general rigid-body collision physics
